summary: Corrected a factual misstatement in the healed-partition fact rather than leaving construction-time feedback standing in for the receipt: the statement had said the restarted side ended as a follower at term 4, but the retained receipt records the opposite direction for the flag-enabled case — the restarted side was the single Leader at term 4 while the other side's committed entry was still present in its store — and only the flag-disabled control ended with the restarted side a follower at term 3 and a single entry. The entry now states the receipt's actual operands and records explicitly that the post-heal winning side varied between construction-time feedback and the retained run, while the substantive claim (one leader after healing, both divergent committed entries still present, the two having been written at the same index and term so each is treated as a duplicate rather than a conflict by AppendEntries) is unchanged. The controller rejected my attempt to name the citing interpretation in affected_uses because no use IDs are tracked for that entry, so the correction rests on the changed-premise explanation alone. Validation passes with that single knowledge update; nothing else changed, and the question remains explained with the defect claim asserted and only store and fault-model boundaries recorded as limitations.
